name: The Shattered Necklace
summary: A broken necklace may be worth something, and you are asked to find its maker. Learning who created it could reveal its value.

sections.title: A Maker to Find
sections.body: Someone wants to learn what the shattered necklace may be worth. You are asked to seek out its original creator, whose identity may help establish its value.

faq.q: Why am I looking for the necklace's creator?
faq.answer: Finding the original creator may help reveal the shattered necklace's potential value.

faq.q: What am I supposed to learn?
faq.answer: You are asked to identify the necklace's original creator and learn about its potential value.
Its potential value is unknown; you are asked to seek its original creator to learn more.
